themes.yaml:
config_version: "3.0"
name: Sample Light
author: Trime Web
description: Gallery fixture：淺色配色 × 主鍵盤／數字鍵盤
style:
  keyboard_height: 180
  keyboard_height_land: 140
  key_height: 36
  key_width: 10
  horizontal_gap: 3
  vertical_gap: 5
  round_corner: 8
  candidate_view_height: 28
  candidate_padding: 5
  key_text_size: 18
  key_long_text_size: 14
  symbol_text_size: 10
  enter_labels:
    default: Enter
    done: 完成
    go: 前往
    next: 下個
    pre: 上個
    search: 搜尋
    send: 發送
fallback_colors:
  candidate_text_color: text_color
preset_color_schemes:
  paper:
    name: Paper
    author: Trime Web
    back_color: 0xf4f1ea
    border_color: 0xd9d3c5
    text_color: 0x2c2924
    text_back_color: 0xeae4d8
    candidate_text_color: 0x2c2924
    comment_text_color: 0x6b6458
    label_color: 0x6b6458
    hilited_text_color: 0x1a1814
    hilited_back_color: 0xddd5c4
    hilited_candidate_text_color: 0xffffff
    hilited_candidate_back_color: 0x3d6b4f
    hilited_comment_text_color: 0xe8f0eb
    hilited_label_color: 0xffffff
    key_text_color: 0x2c2924
    key_back_color: 0xffffff
    key_symbol_color: 0x6b6458
    keyboard_back_color: 0xeae4d8
    hilited_key_text_color: 0xffffff
    hilited_key_back_color: 0x3d6b4f
    hilited_key_symbol_color: 0xffffff
    off_key_back_color: 0xd9d3c5
    off_key_text_color: 0x2c2924
    on_key_back_color: 0x3d6b4f
    on_key_text_color: 0xffffff
  mist:
    name: Mist
    author: Trime Web
    back_color: 0xe8eef4
    border_color: 0xc5d0dc
    text_color: 0x1e2a36
    text_back_color: 0xdce5ee
    candidate_text_color: 0x1e2a36
    comment_text_color: 0x5a6b7a
    label_color: 0x5a6b7a
    hilited_text_color: 0xffffff
    hilited_back_color: 0xb8c8d8
    hilited_candidate_text_color: 0xffffff
    hilited_candidate_back_color: 0x2f6fed
    hilited_comment_text_color: 0xdce8ff
    hilited_label_color: 0xffffff
    key_text_color: 0x1e2a36
    key_back_color: 0xffffff
    key_symbol_color: 0x5a6b7a
    keyboard_back_color: 0xdce5ee
    hilited_key_text_color: 0xffffff
    hilited_key_back_color: 0x2f6fed
    hilited_key_symbol_color: 0xffffff
    off_key_back_color: 0xc5d0dc
    off_key_text_color: 0x1e2a36
    on_key_back_color: 0x2f6fed
    on_key_text_color: 0xffffff
preset_keys:
  Return:
    label: enter_labels
    send: Return
  BackSpace:
    label: ⌫
    send: BackSpace
  Switch_number:
    label: 123
    send: Eisu_toggle
    select: number
  Go_main:
    label: ABC
    send: Eisu_toggle
    select: main
  space:
    label: 空格
    send: space
preset_keyboards:
  main:
    name: 中文
    ascii_mode: 0
    width: 10
    height: 36
    keyboard_height: 180
    keyboard_height_land: 140
    columns: 10
    keys:
      - { click: q, long_click: "!" }
      - { click: w, long_click: "@" }
      - { click: e, long_click: "#" }
      - { click: r, long_click: "$" }
      - { click: t, long_click: "%" }
      - { click: y, long_click: "^" }
      - { click: u, long_click: "&" }
      - { click: i, long_click: "*" }
      - { click: o, long_click: "(" }
      - { click: p, long_click: ")" }
      - { width: 5 }
      - { click: a }
      - { click: s }
      - { click: d }
      - { click: f }
      - { click: g }
      - { click: h }
      - { click: j }
      - { click: k }
      - { click: l }
      - { width: 5 }
      - { click: Switch_number, width: 15, label: 123 }
      - { click: z }
      - { click: x }
      - { click: c }
      - { click: v }
      - { click: b }
      - { click: n }
      - { click: m }
      - { click: BackSpace, width: 15, label: ⌫ }
      - { click: Switch_number, width: 15, label: 123 }
      - { click: "，", width: 10 }
      - { click: space, width: 50, label: 空格 }
      - { click: "。", width: 10 }
      - { click: Return, width: 15 }
  number:
    name: 數字
    ascii_mode: 1
    reset_ascii_mode: true
    width: 10
    height: 36
    keyboard_height: 180
    keyboard_height_land: 140
    columns: 10
    keys:
      - { click: "1", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: "2", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: "3", width: 33.4 }
      - { click: "4", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: "5", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: "6", width: 33.4 }
      - { click: "7", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: "8", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: "9", width: 33.4 }
      - { click: Go_main, width: 33.3, label: ABC }
      - { click: "0", width: 33.3 }
      - { click: BackSpace, width: 33.4, label: ⌫ }
      - { click: "-", width: 25 }
      - { click: ".", width: 25 }
      - { click: space, width: 25, label: 空格 }
      - { click: Return, width: 25 }
